objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Defeat the custom loader's randomisation, get code execution and read the flag.
hints: Every address and the stack cookie come from the same home-made generator.
The scoreboard can read memory relative to its own buffer: collect enough addresses to recover the generator's state.

steps.title: Name what the loader re-implements
steps.prompt: Which exploit mitigation does the custom loader re-implement? (acronym)

steps.title: Identify the generator
steps.prompt: Which kind of pseudo-random generator drives it? (acronym)

steps.title: Find the leak
steps.prompt: Which kind of memory bug in the scoreboard leaks data?

steps.title: Know the second obstacle
steps.prompt: Which protection guards the return address of the overflowing buffer?
